name: Wide Bay Internet
summary: WideBay Internet Services, Bundaberg/Wide Bay QLD dialup ISP serving Bundaberg, Gin Gin, Maryborough and Hervey Bay; operating from at least 1998; now defunct.

events.details: Serving Bundaberg, Gin Gin, Maryborough and Hervey Bay; site counter from 5 Oct 1998.
Death researched Aug 2026: WideBay Internet Services, Bundaberg QLD; counter from Oct 1998; domain widebay.net.au now parked (resolves to AWS). No acquisition/closure news found.
Wayback captures show HTTP 200 content through 03 May 2019 — over 20 years of operation; domain subsequently parked.
